description: This Java source file defines the 'HumanResEvents' class, containing static methods related to processing organizational hierarchy data within the Human Resources module of an Apache OFBiz-based application. It primarily manages retrieval and structuring of employee and department information for building organizational trees, interfacing with OFBiz's entity engine and utilizing request parameters.

classes.name: HumanResEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle organizational hierarchy data fetching and processing for Human Resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getChildHRCategoryTree
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve hierarchical HR category data, populating the request attribute 'hrTree' with a list of categorized organizational data. It coordinates retrieval of employee details, department hierarchies, and employee-in-company mappings.

methods.name: getCurrentEmployeeDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of employees fulfilling a specific position, returning a list of JSON-like maps representing employee nodes for organizational tree rendering.

methods.name: getChildComps
methods.description: Retrieves child organizational units or departments under a specified parent, returning a list of JSON-like maps structured for tree display.

methods.name: getEmployeeInComp
methods.description: Obtains employees associated with a given company or organizational unit, returning a list of JSON-like maps for display within a hierarchy.
